duduk.name: duduk
duduk.looks: a short straight wooden tube (a woodwind, not a smoking pipe) of reddish-brown apricot wood, about 35 cm long, eight finger holes on top, a large flat pale cane reed pushed into its upper end
duduk.not: an oboe, clarinet or flute with metal keys, or a plain stick or board

shofar.name: shofar (ram's horn)
shofar.looks: a ram's horn: a long hollow animal horn, curved and twisted, honey-coloured to dark brown and polished, wide at one end, narrow at the other
shofar.not: a brass trumpet, a bugle or a metal horn

kinnor-lyre.name: kinnor lyre
kinnor-lyre.looks: an ancient lyre: a small wooden sound box, two curved wooden arms rising to a crossbar, about ten gut strings from the box to the crossbar

psaltery.name: psaltery
psaltery.looks: a flat trapezoid wooden box with many metal strings across its top and a carved rose sound hole, laid on the lap

frame-drum.name: frame drum
frame-drum.looks: a large shallow round frame drum about 50 cm across: a thin wooden hoop with a goatskin head, held upright

finger-cymbals.name: finger cymbals
finger-cymbals.looks: tiny brass finger cymbals, two pairs, each the size of a coin, with elastic loops

oud.name: oud
oud.looks: a short-necked lute without frets: a large pear-shaped body with a deeply rounded back of wooden ribs, a pegbox bent back, carved rosettes on its face

qanun.name: qanun
qanun.looks: a large flat trapezoid zither laid on the knees, about eighty strings, small brass levers along one edge, a bridge on stretched skin

ney-flute.name: ney flute
ney-flute.looks: a long end-blown flute of one pale cane, about 70 cm, its nodes showing, six finger holes on the front, a small horn cap at the top

kaval.name: kaval
kaval.looks: a long slender end-blown wooden flute, about 70 cm, open at both ends, eight finger holes, carved rings and horn inlays near its ends

zurna.name: zurna
zurna.looks: a conical dark wooden shawm about 50 cm long widening into a flared bell, a small metal disc and a tiny reed at the top, seven finger holes

darbuka.name: darbuka
darbuka.looks: a goblet-shaped hand drum: a body of metal or clay shaped like a goblet, a taut skin over its wide top, engraved patterns

santur.name: santur
santur.looks: a trapezoid walnut box with many strings over rows of small bridges, two light curved wooden hammers lying on it

bandura.name: bandura
bandura.looks: a large oval wooden lute with a short neck bent to one side and dozens of strings spread across its face like a fan

trembita.name: trembita (alpine horn)
trembita.looks: a mountain horn: a very long straight wooden tube, three metres, wrapped in birch bark, slightly widening at its far end

hammered-dulcimer.name: hammered dulcimer (tsymbaly)
hammered-dulcimer.looks: a trapezoid wooden box with many strings over two bridges, two small wooden hammers on it, set on a stand

sopilka.name: sopilka (low)
sopilka.looks: a slender straight wooden whistle flute about 35 cm long, a whistle mouthpiece at the top, a row of finger holes, burned ornament on the wood

sitar.name: sitar
sitar.looks: a long-necked lute: a large round gourd body, a long wide neck with curved metal frets, a second small gourd near the top, many tuning pegs

tanpura-drone.name: tanpura drone
tanpura-drone.looks: a long-necked drone lute held upright: a large round gourd body, a long plain neck without frets, four long strings

erhu.name: erhu
erhu.looks: a two-string fiddle: a small hexagonal wooden sound box covered with snakeskin, a long thin neck, two pegs at the top, a bow between the two strings

guzheng.name: guzheng
guzheng.looks: a long zither about 1.6 m: a long curved wooden board with 21 strings over movable bridges set in a diagonal row, carved and painted ends

bansuri.name: bansuri
bansuri.looks: a long straight pale bamboo flute blown from the side, a mouth hole near one end and six finger holes in a row, bound with thin red threads

didgeridoo.name: didgeridoo
didgeridoo.looks: a long wooden drone pipe, a hollowed eucalyptus trunk about 1.5 m long, painted with ochre bands and dots, a wax ring at the mouth end

throat-singing-drone.name: throat singing drone
throat-singing-drone.looks: a singer in a robe with fur trim and a pointed hat, eyes closed, on the open steppe, a horse-head fiddle beside

harmonium.name: harmonium
harmonium.looks: a small wooden box on the floor with a keyboard on top and folding bellows at its back

celesta.name: celesta
celesta.looks: a small upright keyboard instrument in a wooden cabinet, like a little piano

glass-harmonica.name: glass harmonica
glass-harmonica.looks: a row of nested glass bowls of graded size on a horizontal iron rod, set in a wooden case

taiko-drums.name: taiko drums
taiko-drums.looks: large barrel drums of dark wood on wooden stands, cowhide heads fastened with rows of studs, thick wooden sticks

kalimba.name: kalimba
kalimba.looks: a small wooden box with a row of thin metal tongues of different lengths fixed across it
kalimba.not: a music box or a toy piano

hang-drum.name: hang drum
hang-drum.looks: a handpan: two shallow steel shells joined like a flying saucer, a dome in the middle and seven or eight dimpled notes around it
hang-drum.not: a wok, a pan or a cymbal

808-drum-machine.name: 808 drum machine
808-drum-machine.looks: a vintage drum machine: a flat box with a row of coloured square buttons and many small knobs

balalaika.name: balalaika
balalaika.looks: a lute with a triangular wooden body, a long fretted neck and three strings

shamisen.name: shamisen
shamisen.looks: a three-string lute: a small square body covered with white skin, a long slender neck without frets, a large flat plectrum beside it

kazoo.name: kazoo
kazoo.looks: a kazoo: a small metal tube with a little round membrane on top

rhodes-electric-piano.name: rhodes electric piano
rhodes-electric-piano.looks: a vintage electric piano with a black top and a silver panel, 73 keys, standing on four chrome legs

wurlitzer-electric-piano.name: wurlitzer electric piano
wurlitzer-electric-piano.looks: a small vintage electric piano in a cream-coloured case, standing on four legs

clavinet.name: clavinet
clavinet.looks: a small vintage electric keyboard in a wooden case with a lid, on four legs

prepared-piano.name: prepared piano
prepared-piano.looks: a grand piano with its lid open, screws, bolts and strips of rubber wedged between its strings

lute.name: lute
lute.looks: a Renaissance lute: a pear-shaped body with a deep rounded back of wooden ribs, a carved rosette on its face, a pegbox bent back at a sharp angle

gusli.name: gusli
gusli.looks: a flat wing-shaped wooden psaltery laid on the knees, ten or more strings fanning across it, carved folk ornament

domra.name: domra
domra.looks: a small lute with a round wooden body, a long fretted neck and three strings

kobza.name: kobza
kobza.looks: a folk lute: an oval round-backed wooden body, a short fretted neck, a few strings, painted ornament

hurdy-gurdy.name: hurdy-gurdy
hurdy-gurdy.looks: a lute-shaped wooden instrument with a crank handle at its end turning a wheel, a box of wooden keys along its neck

nyckelharpa.name: nyckelharpa
nyckelharpa.looks: a long fiddle with a row of wooden keys along its neck and many strings, a short bow beside it

koto.name: koto
koto.looks: a long zither lying on the floor, about 1.8 m: a long wooden board with thirteen strings over tall movable white bridges

pipa.name: pipa
pipa.looks: a pear-shaped lute: a flat pear-shaped wooden body, a short neck bent back, high frets running down onto the body, four strings

pedal-steel-guitar.name: pedal steel guitar
pedal-steel-guitar.looks: a flat rectangular stringed instrument on four legs, two necks of strings across its top, pedals and knee levers below, a steel bar on it

celtic-harp.name: celtic harp
celtic-harp.looks: a small harp: a curved wooden frame with a carved pillar, about thirty strings, Celtic knotwork carved on the wood

ancient-greek-lyre.name: ancient greek lyre
ancient-greek-lyre.looks: an ancient lyre: a tortoise-shell sound box, two curved horns as arms, a crossbar, seven strings

rebab.name: rebab
rebab.looks: a spike fiddle: a small round body covered with skin, a long wooden spike at the bottom, one or two strings, a curved bow

kemenche.name: kemenche
kemenche.looks: a small pear-shaped fiddle with three strings, held upright on the knee, a short bow

bouzouki.name: bouzouki
bouzouki.looks: a long-necked lute: a round deep bowl body of wooden ribs, a long fretted neck, mother-of-pearl inlay around its sound hole

saz.name: saz (baglama)
saz.looks: a long-necked lute: a pear-shaped carved wooden bowl, a very long thin neck with tied frets, seven strings

persian-tar.name: persian tar
persian-tar.looks: a long-necked lute whose body is two carved wooden bowls joined like a figure eight, a thin skin face, tied frets on the neck

viola-da-gamba.name: viola da gamba
viola-da-gamba.looks: a bowed instrument like a cello with sloping shoulders, a flat back and frets on its neck, a bow beside it

zither.name: zither
zither.looks: a flat wooden box zither on a table: frets along its near edge and many open strings behind them

appalachian-dulcimer.name: appalachian dulcimer
appalachian-dulcimer.looks: a long narrow hourglass-shaped wooden box laid on the lap, a fretboard along its length, three or four strings, heart-shaped sound holes

sarangi.name: sarangi
sarangi.looks: a short boxy fiddle carved from one block of wood, a skin face, three thick strings and dozens of thin strings with many pegs on its side

uilleann-pipes.name: uilleann pipes
uilleann-pipes.looks: Irish bellows bagpipes: a cloth-covered bag, a small bellows, a black wooden chanter and three drones with metal keys lying across the lap

shakuhachi.name: shakuhachi
shakuhachi.looks: a thick straight bamboo flute with the bamboo root flaring at its lower end, a sharp slanted cut at the top, five finger holes

english-horn.name: english horn
english-horn.looks: a long dark wooden oboe with silver keys, a bent metal crook holding the reed at the top and a round pear-shaped bell at the bottom

alphorn.name: alphorn
alphorn.looks: a very long wooden horn, about three metres, a narrow straight tube resting on the ground and ending in an upturned wide wooden bell

crumhorn.name: crumhorn
crumhorn.looks: a narrow wooden pipe curved upward at its lower end like the letter J, a wooden cap over the reed at the top, a few finger holes

shawm.name: shawm
shawm.looks: a long conical dark wooden pipe with a wide flared bell, a short reed at the top, finger holes and a perforated wooden barrel near the bottom

aulos.name: aulos (ancient double pipe)
aulos.looks: an ancient double pipe: two long slender pipes of wood or bone held together in a V shape, a leather band beside them

dizi.name: dizi
dizi.looks: a slim bamboo flute blown from the side, a hole covered with thin paper, six finger holes, red silk tassels hanging from one end

suona.name: suona
suona.looks: a Chinese shawm: a conical wooden body with finger holes, a large flared brass bell at the bottom, a small metal tube and tiny reed at the top

sheng.name: sheng
sheng.looks: a Chinese mouth organ: a ring of slender bamboo pipes of different heights rising from a round metal bowl with a short mouthpiece

hulusi.name: hulusi
hulusi.looks: a gourd flute: a dried bottle gourd at the top, three bamboo pipes hanging below it, the middle one with finger holes

natural-horn.name: natural horn (no valves)
natural-horn.looks: a valveless brass horn: a long brass tube coiled in a circle, ending in a wide flared bell, no valves

cajon.name: cajon
cajon.looks: a box drum: a plain wooden box about 50 cm tall with a round sound hole at the back, a player sitting on it

tabla.name: tabla
tabla.looks: a pair of hand drums: a small wooden drum and a larger copper one, each with a black circle in the middle of its skin, laced with leather straps

steel-drums.name: steel drums
steel-drums.looks: a steelpan: a shallow bowl of chromed steel with dimpled note areas hammered into its surface, on a stand

bodhran.name: bodhran
bodhran.looks: a wide shallow round wooden frame drum with a goatskin head, a small wooden double-ended beater beside it

riq.name: riq
riq.looks: a small tambourine with a wooden frame inlaid with mother-of-pearl, five pairs of large brass jingles, a thin translucent head

daf.name: daf
daf.looks: a large round frame drum with many small metal rings hanging inside its wooden frame, a thin skin head

sistrum.name: sistrum
sistrum.looks: an ancient rattle: a bronze U-shaped frame on a handle with loose metal rods and small discs threaded across it

crash-cymbals.name: crash cymbals
crash-cymbals.looks: a pair of large brass crash cymbals with leather straps

singing-bowls.name: singing bowls
singing-bowls.looks: round bowls of hammered bronze in several sizes on small cushions, a wooden striker beside them
singing-bowls.not: ordinary ceramic, porcelain or kitchen bowls

rainstick.name: rainstick
rainstick.looks: a long hollow dried cactus tube closed at both ends, decorated with woven bands

udu.name: udu
udu.looks: a clay pot drum: a round dark terracotta jug with a second hole in its side

talking-drum.name: talking drum
talking-drum.looks: an hourglass-shaped wooden drum with two skin heads laced together by many leather cords, a curved stick beside it

sambuca.name: sambuca strings
sambuca.looks: an ancient triangular harp: a small angular wooden frame, a sound box along one side, strings running at a slant

sambuca-v2.name: sambuca, an ancient triangular harp (sabbeka)
sambuca-v2.looks: an ancient triangular harp: a small angular wooden frame, a sound box along one side, strings running at a slant

crystal-singing-bowls.name: crystal singing bowls
crystal-singing-bowls.looks: frosted white translucent quartz crystal bowls of several sizes, perfectly round, glowing softly from within, a suede-wrapped mallet beside them
crystal-singing-bowls.not: ordinary ceramic, porcelain, glass or kitchen bowls

khomus.name: khomus (Yakut jaw harp)
khomus.looks: a jaw harp: a small forged iron frame shaped like a horseshoe with a long thin steel tongue between its arms
khomus.not: a horseshoe, a key or a pair of tongs

shaman-drum.name: Siberian shaman drum
shaman-drum.looks: a large oval frame drum with a reindeer-skin head painted with red figures, iron pendants hanging inside, a fur-covered beater

morin-khuur.name: morin khuur (horsehead fiddle)
morin-khuur.looks: a tall two-string fiddle: a flat trapezoid wooden sound box, a long straight neck topped by a small carved wooden horse head, two thick strings, a bow beside it
morin-khuur.not: an ordinary violin or cello, or a live horse

igil.name: igil (Tuvan fiddle)
igil.looks: a small two-string fiddle: a narrow wooden body with a skin face, a long neck topped by a small carved wooden horse head, a bow beside it
igil.not: an ordinary violin, or a live horse

shofar-v1.name: shofar blasts, tekiah, shevarim, teruah
shofar-v1.looks: a ram's horn: a long hollow animal horn, curved and twisted, honey-coloured to dark brown and polished, wide at one end, narrow at the other

shofar-v2.name: ancient ram's horn trumpet
shofar-v2.looks: a ram's horn: a long hollow animal horn, curved and twisted, honey-coloured to dark brown and polished, wide at one end, narrow at the other

shofar-v3.name: natural horn as a war signal
shofar-v3.looks: a valveless brass horn: a long brass tube coiled in a circle, ending in a wide flared bell, no valves

shofar-v6.name: primitive animal horn blasts
shofar-v6.looks: a long spiralled antelope horn, ridged and dark, hollow, a mouth hole at its narrow end

shofar-v7.name: Rosh Hashanah shofar calls
shofar-v7.looks: a ram's horn: a long hollow animal horn, curved and twisted, honey-coloured to dark brown and polished, wide at one end, narrow at the other

kinnor-david.name: kinnor, the lyre of King David

kithara.name: kithara, the ancient Greek concert lyre
